rebuttal_or_critique: I acknowledge the divergence in the committee regarding the quantum of the hike. While Professor Varma advocates for a 25 bps adjustment, I must emphasize that with headline inflation at 7.01% and core inflation at 6.20%, the risk of inflation expectations becoming unanchored is acute. A 25 bps move is insufficient to signal our resolve to restore price stability, especially given the current positive output gap of 0.40% and the persistent global volatility reflected in the USD/INR exchange rate. We must not underestimate the risk of second-round effects taking root. Therefore, I stand firm on my 50 bps proposal to decisively move towards a neutral real rate and curb inflationary pressures before they become entrenched.
